ios.desc:
Felt is the highest quality, most personal way to send real, handwritten cards and photos to friends and loved ones. Your handwriting is 100% authentic, like you wrote it with pen and paper. It’s personal mail for the modern world: beautiful, fun and couldn’t be simpler.

SHARK TANK | INSTYLE | NPR | NY TIMES | SXSW | REALSIMPLE | BRIT+CO | GLAMOUR

Use Felt for every occasion:

- Photo Cards
- Thank You
- Birthdays
- Holidays
- Grandparents
- Babies
- Weddings
- Graduations
- Travel
- Invitations 
- Father’s Day
- Mother’s Day
- Anniversary & Love
- Thinking of You
- Get Well Soon
- Congratulations

DETAILS

 - Felt cards are mailed within 24 hrs. Monday - Friday.

 - Cards are 4 inches wide x 4.5 inches tall. We call them card frames. You can connect up to four frames to create one amazing card!

 - Select from cards made by famous designs and discover unique works by independent artists.

 - We use premium Mohawk paper and envelopes.

 - We hand apply a first class stamp.

 - You can send your Felt card to one person or multiple recipients at once.

 - Felt cards start at just $4.50 (including postage) or send 3 cards for $6 a month.

 - Volume discounts are available in the app for larger card sending needs.

 - Make it a gift by adding fresh-cut flowers, real cash money or select a gift card from popular brands.

 - Adding contacts is easy! Import them right from your phone into the app or upload a spreadsheet here: https://myfelt.feltapp.com/addressbook.


HOW IT WORKS 

Just select one of our many original card designs, or select a photo from your phone. Then write a personal message on the front or back of the card with a stylus or just your finger. (Don’t worry you can type too, and we have several fun designer fonts to choose from.) You can then add up to three additional photos to your order, or a gift card. We print your cards, photos and handwritten message on premium Mohawk card stock. 

Multiple card frames come in our own unique square accordion-style format, with micro-perforations between each fold. We seal them by hand, add a first class hand-applied stamp and try to mail them within 24hrs.

We go to great lengths to make sure the final product is as personal and heartfelt as if you sent it yourself. 

You can send a Felt card to just one person or send the same card or photos to lots of friends and family, to share and preserve your special memories. Felt is used by brides and new mom’s for sending all their thank you’s and it’s perfect
